title: The Cech complex of a covering on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $\mathcal U=\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ a covering of $\mathcal C$ (so all fibre products $U_{t_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{t_p}$ exist in $\mathcal C$, Sites Definition 00VH (3) and induction), and $\mathcal F$ a presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal C$. The *Cech complex* $\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ has in degree $p\ge0$ the group $\prod_{(t_0,\ldots,t_p)\in T^{p+1}}\mathcal F(U_{t_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{t_p})$ and differential $d(s)_{t_0\ldots t_{p+1}}=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^js_{t_0\ldots\hat{t_j}\ldots t_{p+1}}|_{U_{t_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{t_{p+1}}}$ (restriction along the projection omitting the $j$-th factor); $d\circ d=0$. Its cohomology is the *Cech cohomology* $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$. It is a functor of $\mathcal F$ (a map of presheaves acts componentwise), exact on presheaves. (General-site version of [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex], which is stated for the small etale site.)

mathlib_searches.verdict: candidate, not a one-line specialization: requires HasFiniteProducts on the category; on a site in Stacks' sense only the fibre products of the members of a covering exist, so Over U need not have finite products (it does for the small etale site, where def-weil-pbc-cech-complex is the leaf). The general version FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor (same file) applied to a Cech nerve simplicial object in FormalCoproduct C would cover it, but that nerve is not in Mathlib for a family with only some fibre products
